subject: Evidence transfer: admin activity exports & retention policy inquiry
messages:
From: Anne Reed <anne.reed@healthwave.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@healthwave.com, procure@healthwave.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit evidence request — admin activity and retention details

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing our SIG/CAIQ response and need a scoped export of Redwood’s admin activity for our SOC 2 evidence bundle. Specifically: a) which admin actions are recorded (user management, role changes, API key lifecycle, model pinning/rollouts, console logins, and agent actions), b) retention windows per event type, and c) recommended export formats and transfer methods for a secure handoff (S3 presigned, encrypted archive, or on-prem scp).

Can you also confirm whether logs include object-level timestamps in UTC, the originating IP, and whether any PII is present (we would prefer redacted exports if possible)? Our compliance deadline is next Friday (2026-08-20). If you can provide a checklist and a tentative delivery ETA, that would be great.

Thanks,
Anne
Anne Reed
Head of Security — HealthWave Systems
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Anne Reed <anne.reed@healthwave.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence request — admin activity and retention details

Anne — thanks for the clear ask. We can do this. High level answers up front:
- Events logged: admin console logins, console UI actions (create/update/delete on user/role/policy), API key create/revoke, model version pin/unpin, rollout/rollback events, job scheduling actions, and operator-initiated maintenance tasks.
- Fields captured per event: timestamp (UTC), actor (internal account id + name), actor IP, event_type, object_id, object_type, session_id, request_id, pre/post state diffs for config changes (where applicable).
- Retention: default 365 days for admin activity; 90 days for ephemeral session traces. We have longer-term archive options (up to 7 years) under our Dedicated/Private contracts — we can provide a signed snapshot for your SOC 2 bundle.

Options for transfer:
1) Secure S3 bundle (recommended): encrypted ZIP (AES-256), delivered via presigned URL with 7-day expiry + SHA256 checksum and signed chain-of-custody PDF.
2) Direct SFTP/SSH push to a HealthWave endpoint (customer-managed key exchange).
3) Encrypted physical transfer (only for extremely sensitive/legal requirements).

We can apply redaction rules to remove user emails/PII from the exported rows, or provide a pseudonymized dataset plus a separate identity mapping under an encrypted key escrow if you require.

I’ll loop in Ops (Vanessa & Karthik) to schedule the extraction and produce the export manifest. ETA for a scoped bundle: 48–72 hours once we agree on timeframe and export window.

Shall we target a 2026-08-17 midnight UTC snapshot covering 2026-03-01 through 2026-08-01?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Anne Reed <anne.reed@healthwave.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Audit evidence request — admin activity and retention details

Vanessa / Karthik — can you take lead on the export for HealthWave (deal HW-2489)? Requirements:
- Snapshot window: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z (as Anne requested).
- Deliverables: CSV export of events (one row per event), a manifest describing columns and redaction steps, a compressed tar.gz encrypted with AES-256.
- Metadata: include UTC timestamps, actor id + display name, actor IP, object_type/id, event_type, request_id, pre/post diffs for config changes.
- Redaction: remove email addresses for end-user accounts; keep internal operator display names. Produce both (A) redacted CSV and (B) pseudonymized CSV + identity mapping encrypted and stored in KMS.
- Transfer: preferred method S3 presigned link. Provide SHA256 checksum and sign chain_of_custody_initial.pdf.
- Legal: mark snapshot as read-only and include a custody manifest.

Please attach the initial manifest and a sample of 10 anonymized rows for HealthWave’s security team to review. Anne’s deadline is 2026-08-20. Confirm ETA.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Anne Reed <anne.reed@healthwave.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit evidence request — admin activity and retention details

Marissa / team — taking this on. Plan and outputs below:

Planned extraction steps:
1) Freeze window: create point-in-time snapshot of admin ledger at 2026-08-17T00:00:00Z (we’ll snapshot the underlying event store to ensure consistent diffs).
2) Export: stream events into a staging S3 bucket as CSV partitions (daily files) and then bundle into admin-activity-20260301_20260801.tar.gz.
3) Redaction: run our redaction pipeline (rules in redaction_rules_summary.txt) to remove consumer PII and obfuscate emails; internal operator display names preserved. Produce two bundles: redacted_bundle and pseudonymized_bundle + identity_mapping.enc.
4) Packaging: encrypt final archive with an ephemeral encryption key; wrap key with your KMS public key (we’ll provide key wrapping instructions).
5) Signing & custody: generate SHA256 checksum, produce chain_of_custody_initial.pdf (signed by Redwood Ops lead), and provide TTL-limited presigned URL.

ETA: preliminary sample + manifest attached within 24 hours; full bundles ready in 48 hours after sample approval (so target full delivery 2026-08-18 16:00:00Z PDT).

Attachments (stubs):
- admin_activity_manifest_20260815.csv (column list + examples)
- redaction_rules_summary.txt
- chain_of_custody_initial.pdf (unsigned stub, will sign on final delivery)

Security notes: all exports will include UTC timestamps and actor IPs. Session traces older than 90 days will be aggregated and will not include full live session tokens. If HealthWave needs raw session traces beyond 90 days, we’ll need a dedicated export approval and additional legal signoff.

Anne — please confirm you’re OK with the redaction approach and the delivery ETA.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anne Reed <anne.reed@healthwave.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procure@healthwave.com
Date: 2026-08-18T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence transfer: admin activity exports & retention policy inquiry

Marissa / Vanessa — this looks good. Thanks for the clear plan and the sample. A few quick confirmations before we proceed to delivery:
- Confirm that the identity_mapping.enc will be transferred separately and only available to HealthWave’s security leadership via our key (we do not want mapping delivered inside the same archive).
- Please provide the signed chain_of_custody_initial.pdf with delivery and indicate who will be the signing authority.
- We’ll accept the S3 presigned transfer; please send the presigned URL and the SHA256 checksum at the time of upload.

Procurement note: we’ll need an export affidavit for our records confirming the date/time of extraction and the person who executed the package creation.

If you can deliver the final bundle today (2026-08-18) by 18:00 PDT, we’ll mark this as complete on our side.

Best,
Anne
Anne Reed
Head of Security — HealthWave Systems
